mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yan_notification_outbox(article_id,author_id,task_key,cursor_follower_id,status,retry_count,max_retry,next_retry_at,rerun_requested) VALUES(#{articleId},#{authorId},#{taskKey},0,'PENDING',0,#{maxRetry},NOW(3),0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE article_id=VALUES(article_id),author_id=VALUES(author_id),max_retry=VALUES(max_retry),retry_count=CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') THEN 0 ELSE retry_count END,cursor_follower_id=CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED') THEN 0 ELSE cursor_follower_id END,next_retry_at=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN next_retry_at ELSE NOW(3) END,locked_until=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN locked_until ELSE NULL END,last_error=NULL,dead_letter_at=NULL,rerun_requested=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,status=CASE WHEN status='PROCESSING' THEN status ELSE 'PENDING' END,update_time=NOW(3)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM yan_notification_outbox WHERE status='PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status='PROCESSING',locked_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3)
UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status='PENDING',cursor_follower_id=#{cursorFollowerId},locked_until=NULL,next_retry_at=NOW(3),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN rerun_requested=1 THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SUCCEEDED' END,locked_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,next_retry_at=CASE WHEN rerun_requested=1 THEN NOW(3) ELSE next_retry_at END,rerun_requested=0,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'

UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN retry_count+1 >= max_retry THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,next_retry_at=CASE WHEN retry_count+1 >= max_retry THEN next_retry_at ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND) END,locked_until=NULL,last_error=#{reason},dead_letter_at=CASE WHEN retry_count+1 >= max_retry THEN NOW(3) ELSE dead_letter_at END,retry_count=retry_count+1,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET process_count=process_count+1,last_process_at=NOW(3),update_time=NOW(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET status='PENDING',locked_until=NULL,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND locked_until < NOW(3)

UPDATE yan_notification_outbox SET retry_count=CASE WHEN status='FAILED' THEN 0 ELSE retry_count END,status='PENDING',next_retry_at=NOW(3),locked_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,dead_letter_at=NULL,rerun_requested=0,update_time=NOW(3) WHERE status IN ('PENDING','FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT follower_id FROM yan_user_follow WHERE followee_id=#{authorId} AND follower_id > #{cursorFollowerId} ORDER BY follower_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM yan_user_follow WHERE followee_id=#{authorId}
